summary: The hand-written raw POST used for TTS, voice design, model creation, and ASR never replays a request after a transport error, unreadable response, or 5xx; only 429 is retried.
reason: Each of those calls starts billed or side-effecting work and the server may have accepted it before the failure was observed. The previous loop retried up to 3 times, so one gateway error could bill up to 4 generations. ASR keeps its own explicit single 503 retry.
validated_outcome: TestPostRawDoesNotReplayAfterAmbiguousFailure: old code sent the POST 4 times on 500/503, new code sends it once; TestPostRawRetriesRateLimit still recovers from a 429.
